title: MNSS's Cat Sounds
description: Makes Cat sounds Better i suppose?
body:
This resource pack replaces the default in-game cat sounds with recordings of my own cat, giving Minecraft a more personal and unique feel. Instead of the standard meows and purrs, you’ll hear real, authentic sounds that add charm and personality to your world.

The project is simple but fun: it enhances immersion by making cats feel more alive and distinct. Every interaction, whether a cat is walking around, getting hurt, or just idling, uses custom audio, making gameplay a bit more entertaining and fresh, especially if you enjoy small but noticeable changes.

This pack is lightweight, easy to install, and fully compatible with version 1.21 (Even though it's old), so you won’t have to worry about performance issues or complicated setup. It’s designed for players who like customizing their game without changing core mechanics.

Why download it? If you’re bored of the default sounds or just want something different, this pack is a cool way to personalize your experience. It’s especially great for cat lovers or anyone who enjoys quirky, creative modifications.

Overall, it’s a small but fun upgrade that brings a bit of real-life personality into Minecraft!
